t: You're looking at Helios, a three-metre-high gilded bronze statue at Television Centre in White City. It's part of the Helios Building, which is a listed building. The sculptor was Thomas Bayliss Huxley-Jones, an English sculptor known for making public works for towns and cities across Britain. He created Helios in 1960. The statue was restored and returned to this site in 2017, so the gilding you see is from that restoration. Look up at the figure and take in its scale.
